example.title: Middletown Bridge, old Michigan Road over Conn's Creek
example.place: northwest of Middletown, Liberty Township, Shelby County, IN

brief: Multi-arch rough-stone bridge of 1903 on the old alignment of an early state road, now a quiet one-lane gravel lane: a row of small semicircular arches (four to five) in coursed limestone rubble walls, capped by a low solid stone parapet with flat coping on each side, W-beam guardrail and black-and-white hazard boards added at the ends. Creek in scrub woodland with houses nearby.

traits.railing_detail: low solid rubble parapet with coping
